periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation inclined approximately 45-60 degrees toward the midline of the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated ovoid shapes with a high vertical-to-horizontal ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward elongation with the lower margin tapering towards the infraorbital region.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped curve along the posterior boundary where it meets the white dorsal fur.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Broad transverse band occupying roughly 40-50 percent of the visible lateral torso profile.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide horizontal separation across a broad, white cranial apex.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: High degree of circularity with smooth, rounded superior margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-buff tinting visible on the fur of the lower posterior and hindquarters compared to the bright white dorsal region.
